title: The Cantrill Strikes Back | BSD Now 117
summary: An episode of the BSD Now podcast in which Bryan Cantrill joins the hosts to rant about Linux interfaces, alongside the week's BSD headlines. The conversation also touches on containers and related systems topics.
why: Cited as a casual, insightful conversation with Cantrill, and referenced for his views on containers and unikernels.

quote.text: I also found the somewhat more casual BSDnow podcasts that featured Mr. Cantrill quite insightful
